text.tspan: To Place a Call
1. Lift the handset from the cradle.
A steady dial tone will be emitted from the receiver.
2. Insert a finger into the hole corresponding with the digit to be dialled.
Rotate the dial in a clockwise manner fully to the metal finger-stop.
Release the dial and allow it to wind back to the starting position.
Repeat until all digits have been dialled, and wait.
3. When presented with an in-call menu, you may dial numbers as normal.
In the event that the hash '#' or asterisk '*' symbol must be dialled, hang-up
and contact the operator for assistance.
5. When the call has ended, or to end the call, return the handset to the cradle.
NOTE – Dial numbers deliberately, pausing for a brief moment between digits
PLEASE USE THIS CARD FROM
1700 HOURS ON 28th MAY, 1995
AND DESTROY ANY PREVIOUS ISSUE
INSTRUCTION SET
GPO 746F WTF
Wireless Telephony Functionality
To Receive a Call
1. Ensure the handset is returned to the cradle.
2. In the event of an incoming call, a bell will sound.
3. Lift the handset to receive the call. The bell will cease ringing.
4. Speak clearly into the mouthpiece.
State the name of your local exchange and the last four digits of
your phone number to announce yourself.
5. As previously, return handset to cradle once the call is completed.
Power Specifications
The device is intended to operate with an input of 5.1V D.C. of no less
than 1.3A and up to 2.5A.
Officially issued power supply units should be used at all times.
There may be future provisions to utilise a 12V battery pack as a power source.
The post office does not bear any responsibility for usage of the 746F WTF
outwith these parameters.
Starting/Stopping the Device
There is a power button located between the handset and the dial.
Firmly press it once to turn the device on, and twice in quick succession to turn it off.
The LED housed inside indicates the device is active when lit.
remove the power source unless it is dimmed.
DO NOT
ON HIS MAJESTY'S SERVICE
